behavior-tests.source: Shipped Lockdown 21 applies Rooted for 12 seconds. The executor uses the selected hostile target and does not attach the damage-break callback used by Code Freeze.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityHandler admits only a live eligible selection. TimedEffects installs Rooted, and movement validation corrects the position while the root is active. The same movement becomes valid after natural expiry.
behavior-tests.test: StarterCoderSplashBatchMode checks friendly refusal and a 10 IS debit, 2 s cast, 13.5 s reuse, target root, root survival through landed Static Blast, position correction and later remote movement. PR504 native capture confirms X 25200 during the root and X 25220 after it. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/504

notes.PR504: Lockdown completes the last behavior check. Static Blast and the two Tinkering splash casts remain scoped controls. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/504
notes.PR505: Native Hindering Shot succeeds at rest on a fresh login. PR505 headless also verifies the active-interlock path and invalid-handle refusal. Exact damage scaling, the movement/Force Combat stat consumers and wider targeting checks remain open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/505
notes.PR506: Calm Mind to Empty Mind removes Thrown +75 before applying Viral +75. Desperation samples +50 Initiative at half health. This confirms the current values and reuse on stock, while the original resistance and initiative consumers remain open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/506
notes.PR508: The regenerated PR508 audit is the baseline, including the earlier PR503/507 evidence.
notes.PR509: Head Butt stays grey before Daze and queues after Daze. In ordinary interlock the native capture has animation 284, 40 damage and Melee Accuracy -10 for 20 s. The exact replay verifies the Dazed refusal with required-state bit 2. Damage remains open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/509
notes.PR511: The stock run confirms 254 and 255 refuse an empty selection and cast on QAEnemy at rest. A handgun swap gives the existing 130 control. Headless verifies live hostile scope, including friendly and stale refusals. Both rifle damage bases and the untested range, LOS and contest aspects stay open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/511
notes.PR512: With QAFar held, UI Lag reaches QAEnemy only. Slow and Code Freeze reach QAFar only. QAOther receives none. This covers area centre and allegiance while wider targeting and the stat/control consumers stay open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/512
